Open data

Download computed cell data for individual countries or the world.

License & attribution requirement

Products or services using data derived from OpenCelliD need to visibly credit OpenCelliD. See our license and attribution guidance for credit formats and placement examples.

Exceptions to the OpenCelliD attribution requirement can be granted in writing by Unwired Labs ([email protected]). The project contributors grant Unwired Labs the license to give such exceptions.

Country-specific exports

Exports are generated daily by 02:00 AM GMT and include cells observed in the last 18 months. Fair usage allows two downloads of each file per day.

Frequently asked questions

What fields are included in the CSV files?

See the database format documentation for column names, types and field descriptions.

Why do exports only include the last 18 months?

Cell configurations change over time. The observation window helps keep exports relevant, file sizes manageable and server bandwidth available. The API can access older available data.

Why does my country have statistics but no download?

A country may have historical observations but no data within the export's 18-month window. Try the cell position API for individual lookups.

Why can I find a cell through the API but not in a CSV?

CSV exports only include cells observed in the last 18 months. The API can respond with older available observations as well.
